#!/usr/bin/env python3 """ Send order details for ORD-6C71B1 to bob@example.com via email. Before running, update the SMTP configuration below with your email server credentials. Usage: python3 send_order_email.py """ import smtplib from email.mime.text import MIMEText from email.mime.multipart import MIMEMultipart # ────────────────────────────────────────────── # SMTP Configuration – update these values # ────────────────────────────────────────────── SMTP_HOST = "smtp.example.com" # e.g. smtp.gmail.com SMTP_PORT = 587 # 587 for TLS, 465 for SSL SMTP_USER = "your_email@example.com" SMTP_PASS = "your_password" SENDER = "your_email@example.com" # ────────────────────────────────────────────── RECIPIENT = "bob@example.com" SUBJECT = "Order Details – ORD-6C71B1" # Order details order = { "Order ID": "ORD-6C71B1", "Customer": "Maya Chen", "Date": "2026-09-02", "Status": "Cancelled", "Items": "Anker Portable Bluetooth Speaker", "Total Paid": "$79", } # Build plain-text body text_body = "Order Details\n" + "=" * 40 + "\n" for key, value in order.items(): text_body += f"{key:>12}: {value}\n" # Build HTML body html_body = """\

Order Details

""" for key, value in order.items(): html_body += f' \n' html_body += """\
FieldValue
{key}{value}
""" # Compose message msg = MIMEMultipart("alternative") msg["From"] = SENDER msg["To"] = RECIPIENT msg["Subject"] = SUBJECT msg.attach(MIMEText(text_body, "plain")) msg.attach(MIMEText(html_body, "html")) # Send try: with smtplib.SMTP(SMTP_HOST, SMTP_PORT) as server: server.ehlo() server.starttls() server.ehlo() server.login(SMTP_USER, SMTP_PASS) server.sendmail(SENDER, RECIPIENT, msg.as_string()) print(f"✅ Email sent successfully to {RECIPIENT}") except Exception as e: print(f"❌ Failed to send email: {e}")
